units.rawText: What a marvelous device this is. I've never seen it in the shrine before. It looks quite complex, yet it's so easy to use...

units.rawText: Now that you mention it, that applies to me as well, but my environment is such that I've almost forgotten about it.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, the objects in the shrine might appear simple, but the ceremonial rites surrounding them are most complex and thus much care is needed when using them.
